summary: A self-zapped wand of opening reaches zap.c:release_hold and mhitu.c:expels(TRUE), while JavaScript records the call as unported. Completing expels requires updating its gulpmu caller in js/mhitu.js, whose source and write path are currently reserved.

source.branch: When the hero self-zaps with WAN_OPENING or SPE_KNOCK while held or swallowed, zapyourself calls release_hold; the swallowed arm of release_hold calls expels(mtmp, mtmp->data, TRUE).
callers: zap.c:dozap() calls zapyourself() when a directed wand has zero direction at line 2658.
zap.c:zapyourself() calls release_hold() for WAN_OPENING and SPE_KNOCK when u.ustuck is set at lines 2929-2935.
zap.c:bhitm() also calls release_hold() for WAN_OPENING and SPE_KNOCK at line 390.
dependencies: mhitu.c:expels() is the required swallowed branch callee. Its TRUE-message branch must coexist with its existing FALSE-message relocation path.
mhitu.c:gulpmu() is another expels() caller at lines 1572 and 1584. B224 reserves that function and the shared js/mhitu.js write path through its pending unleash_all delivery.
